title: SunPath Solar Lease Monthly Rate Card
content:
**SunPath Solar Lease — monthly payment, annual escalator, term and prepayment price by system size.**

| Tier | Monthly lease payment, first lease year | Annual escalator | Lease term | Full prepayment price at signing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SunPath 3.2 kW | $69.00 | 0.0 percent | 20 years | $14900.00 |
| SunPath 4.0 kW | $82.00 | 0.0 percent | 20 years | $18300.00 |
| SunPath 4.8 kW | $95.00 | 1.9 percent | 20 years | $21700.00 |
| SunPath 5.6 kW | $108.00 | 1.9 percent | 25 years | $25100.00 |
| SunPath 6.4 kW | $121.00 | 2.9 percent | 25 years | $28500.00 |
| SunPath 8.0 kW | $147.00 | 2.9 percent | 25 years | $35200.00 |

### Column meanings

- **Monthly lease payment, first lease year** — the monthly lease payment, in US dollars, in the first lease year.
- **Annual escalator** — the increase of the monthly lease payment on each lease anniversary, in percent.
- **Lease term** — the lease term in years, counted from the permission-to-operate date.
- **Full prepayment price at signing** — the price, in US dollars, to prepay the whole lease at signing.

### Reading the card

- The SunPath 3.2 kW and SunPath 4.0 kW payments carry a 0.0 percent escalator, so their monthly payment does not rise on a lease anniversary.
- The SunPath 4.8 kW and SunPath 5.6 kW payments rise by 1.9 percent on each lease anniversary; the SunPath 6.4 kW and SunPath 8.0 kW payments by 2.9 percent.
- The three smallest sizes run for 20 years from the permission-to-operate date, the three largest for 25 years.
- Hypothetical illustration of the term: a SunPath 5.6 kW lease whose permission to operate fell on a given date runs 25 years from that date; a SunPath 4.0 kW lease with the same date runs 20 years.
